paper: Hansen (2015) AER - Punishment and Deterrence: Evidence from Drunk Driving
replication_type: From-scratch R reimplementation of the paper's local-linear RD (equation 1); original Stata archive account-gated.

environment.gpu_note: Not applicable - econometric RD on a 214k-row cross-section runs in seconds on CPU.

data.note: Mixtape SUBSET (214,558 of the paper's 512,964 tests). Missing: county, prior-test count/offense flag, PBT, recidivism-type splits, person ID -> cols 2-3 of Tables 3/4, Prior/PBT of Table 2, and Fig 2 Prior/PBT & Fig 3 Panels B/C are NOT reproducible.

table4_agg_015.verdict: correct negative sign, smaller magnitude (subset + absent county/prior controls; see S2)

key_results.table2_balance: all coefs small vs SE at both thresholds (male/white/age/accident); matches paper -> supports RD assumption

density_tests.verdict: McCrary over-rejects on this discrete/curved subset (S1); Frandsen does not reject (consistent with paper's no-manipulation conclusion)

figures.figure1: smooth single-peaked BAC distribution through both thresholds
figures.figure3: clear downward recidivism drop at BOTH 0.08 and 0.15 - headline result reproduced

omissions_disclosed: Tables 3 & 4 cols (2) no-prior and (3) prior: prior-test variable absent from subset
Table 2 Prior & PBT columns: variables absent
Figure 2 Prior & PBT panels: variables absent
Figure 3 first-time/repeat panels (B/C): prior variable absent
County + prior-offense controls omitted from Tables 3/4 regressions (absent in subset; paper App. Tables 1/2 report ~equivalent results without controls)
